# Version 4.157.1 (Unreleased)
> **Vulkan driver error recovery**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.157.1 avoids unsafe Vulkan descriptor-pool destruction after allocation failures on Imagination drivers.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Safer Imagination Vulkan allocation failure handling** — Ganesh and Graphite abandon affected descriptor pools after host or device out-of-memory errors rather than destroy them in an unsafe state. Graphite also rejects further allocations through the null pool handle. The workaround deliberately trades pool cleanup for safety on affected drivers. ([#5838](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5838))
